principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator and AreaCalculator classes are handling both the calculation of areas/volumes and the validation of shapes, thus violating the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the shape validation logic into its own class or method, ensuring that calculation classes focus solely on calculations.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator's sum method needs modification whenever a new shape type is introduced, violating the Open/Closed Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use the Strategy pattern for area calculation by creating an interface for area computation, allowing new shapes to be added without modifying existing code.

principle_violations.reason: Both sum methods in VolumeCalculator and AreaCalculator have similar structures and logic, violating the DRY principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Extract the duplicate summation logic into a separate private method that can be called in both sum methods.
